query:
WITH clienti_conti AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.nome, c.data_nascita, co.saldo, co.numero_conto, co.data_apertura
    FROM clienti c NATURAL JOIN conti co
), classifica AS (
    SELECT id, nome, saldo, data_nascita,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY saldo DESC) AS posizione,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY saldo DESC) AS posizione_densa,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE saldo > 1000) OVER () AS clienti_ricchi_count,
        SUM(saldo) OVER () AS totale_depositi,
        AVG(saldo) OVER () AS saldo_medio_finestra
    FROM clienti_conti
), statistiche AS (
    SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_nascita) AS anno_nascita,
        COUNT(*) AS numero_clienti,
        AVG(saldo) AS saldo_medio,
        MAX(saldo) AS saldo_massimo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN saldo > 1000 THEN saldo ELSE 0 END) AS totale_soldi_ricchi,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE saldo > 1000) AS conto_ricchi
    FROM clienti_conti
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM data_nascita)
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 AND AVG(saldo) > 0
), clienti_senza_conto AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.nome
    FROM clienti c
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conti co WHERE co.id = c.id)
), clienti_importanti AS (
    SELECT id, nome, saldo FROM clienti_conti WHERE saldo > 1000
    UNION
    SELECT id, nome, 0 AS saldo FROM clienti_senza_conto
)
SELECT cl.nome AS nome_cliente,
    cl.saldo AS saldo_conto,
    cl.posizione,
    cl.posizione_densa,
    cl.clienti_ricchi_count,
    cl.totale_depositi,
    cl.saldo_medio_finestra,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clienti_conti) AS totale_clienti_con_conto,
    (SELECT SUM(saldo) FROM clienti_conti) AS somma_totale_soldi,
    (SELECT AVG(saldo) FROM clienti_conti) AS saldo_medio_generale,
    (SELECT MAX(saldo) FROM clienti_conti) AS saldo_massimo,
    (SELECT MIN(saldo) FROM clienti_conti) AS saldo_minimo,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clienti_senza_conto) AS totale_clienti_senza_conto,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clienti_conti cc1 JOIN clienti_conti cc2 ON cc1.id < cc2.id) AS totale_confronti,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE saldo > 1000) FROM clienti_conti) AS conto_ricchi_subquery,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statistiche) AS gruppi_per_anno_nascita
FROM classifica cl
JOIN clienti_importanti ci ON cl.id = ci.id
WHERE cl.posizione <= 3
ORDER BY cl.posizione
LIMIT 3;
